name: What is the difference between smooth finish and sand finish stucco?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between smooth finish and sand finish stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference between smooth and sand finish stucco lies in their appearance and application. Smooth finish stucco offers a sleek, contemporary look without visible aggregate, requiring meticulous application to avoid imperfections. Sand finish stucco incorporates fine sand into the mix, resulting in a slightly gritty, textured surface that can help mask minor irregularities. Smooth is often chosen for modern aesthetics, while sand provides a more classic, subtle texture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smooth finish stucco is sleek and aggregate-free, ideal for modern homes; sand finish has a fine, gritty texture from sand in the mix.
